{"consolidated_memory":"FOUR SEPARATE NaN FEATURE ENCODER INCIDENTS IN ml/features/encoder.py

All four occasions involved the same symptom (NaN value appearing in one output column when encoding batches holding sparse columns) in ml/features/encoder.py (ml pipeline side), but with four different root causes, each fixed independently.

**Occasion 1: [2026-03-21]**
- Trigger: Users sitting in negative UTC offset
- Root cause: Off-by-one in slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test
- PR: #2610, branch: fix/nan-feature-1
- Result: Reclaimed 77 GB of blob storage
- Test coverage: tests/ml/test_encoder.py

**Occasion 2: [2026-03-26]**
- Trigger: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #3338, branch: fix/nan-feature-2
- Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 18 days running

**Occasion 3: [2026-04-03]**
- Trigger: Only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: Race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR: #5308, branch: fix/nan-feature-3
- Result: Cold start dropped 36 percent, to 153 ms

**Occasion 4: [2026-07-18]**
- Trigger: Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR: #8116, branch: fix/nan-feature-4
- Result: Throughput rose 36 percent, to 640 requests per second

Stack: Python. Repro procedure (consistent across all four): encode the batch holding the sparse column."}
